name: Deepak Nitrite Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1970, Deepak Nitrite Ltd manufactures Basic Intermediates, Fine & Speciality Chemicals, Performance Products, and Phenolics [1]

flags.text: Revenue compounded 12.6% a year over 5 years but profit shrank 6.6% a year: growth is getting less profitable
Capital work-in-progress is 31% of fixed assets: a big build-out is still to be commissioned

business.what: Deepak Nitrite makes specialty and industrial chemicals, mainly phenolics (phenol, acetone, IPA) and advanced intermediates (nitration, amines, agchem). It earns by selling these chemicals to industrial customers, with expansion into polycarbonate and specialty chemicals underway.

segments.name: Phenolics
segments.share: ~74% (computed: INR 2,291 cr of INR 3,091 cr Q2 revenue)
segments.comment: Record quarterly revenue and EBIT up 23% QoQ; EBIT margin ~22%.

segments.name: Advanced Intermediates
segments.share: ~26% (computed: INR 811 cr of INR 3,091 cr Q2 revenue)
segments.comment: Revenue up 38% YoY, flat QoQ; EBIT fell to INR 49 cr on input costs.

ledger.promise: MIBK/MIBC project commissioned in Q4 FY26, revenue reported from Q1 FY27
ledger.quote: The MIBK/ MIBC project is progressing well and is targeted for commissioning within this quarter.
ledger.actual: Moved to end of Q1/early Q2 FY27 (Q4 call), then August 2026 (Q1 call). The Q2 FY27 call says it runs at about 60% utilization. About two quarters late.

ledger.promise: Q4 FY26 to be better than Q3 FY26
ledger.quote: I definitely expect Q4 FY26 to be better than Q3 FY26.
ledger.actual: Q4 FY26 EBITDA 376 vs 211 in Q3; PAT 220 vs 100; margin 17.7% vs 10.7%.

ledger.promise: Nitric acid, nitration and hydrogenation assets at about 95-105% utilization from Q4 FY26
ledger.quote: we are expecting to run at 100% or close enough to 100% utilization from this quarter onwards. They may be between 95% to 100%, 105%.
ledger.actual: Q4 FY26 call: the nitric acid plant ran at about 45% utilization, and fixes with suppliers were still under way.

ledger.promise: Nitric acid project to add Rs 90-100 crore EBITDA once stable
ledger.quote: once the plant is under stable operations, we do anticipate the kind of target that we're looking at.
ledger.actual: No segment or plant-level EBITDA is disclosed, and no later call reports whether the plant reached stable operations.

ledger.promise: High-pressure alkylation asset commissioned June-July 2026, ramp-up over 2-3 months
ledger.quote: on the high - pressure alkylation asset, which will come in around between June and July 2026, that will have a ramp-up over two to three months basis the customer requirement.
ledger.actual: Q1 FY27 call: alkylation and multipurpose plants slipped a couple of months, with commercial volumes now from January 2027.

ledger.promise: Q1 FY27 better than Q4 FY26 on standalone and consolidated basis
ledger.quote: our Q1 looks on track for numbers, which are better than Q4, whether it is on standalone or on a consolidated basis.
ledger.actual: Consolidated Q1 FY27 EBITDA 540 vs 376; PAT 345 vs 220; margin 20.9% vs 17.7%. Standalone figures not provided.

ledger.promise: Stronger margin profile in FY27 than FY26, including standalone
ledger.quote: in FY27, we expect a stronger margin profile, even for the standalone business, compared with FY26.
ledger.actual: Consolidated H1 FY27 EBITDA margin 20.6% (1,167/5,654) vs FY26 12.5% (987/7,887). Standalone figures not provided.

ledger.quote: INR 2,500 crore is for FY27, not FY26.
ledger.actual: Q1 FY27 call: a further Rs 1,000-1,500 crore this year. Q2 FY27 call: Rs 800-900 crore in H2 FY27. The full-year total is not given.

ledger.quote: December 2027 is the timeline we had discussed for being onstream.
ledger.actual: Pushed to June 2028 (Q4 FY26 call), then H2 (Q1 FY27 call), then FY29 (Q2 FY27 call).

ledger.promise: Polycarbonate project cost about Rs 11,000 crore, 60:40 debt:equity
ledger.quote: So, the total project, what we have announced is around INR11,000 crore. We have tied up with the banks for debt. It will be in the ratio of 60 -40.
ledger.actual: Q1 FY27 call cites an Rs 11,500 crore programme with about Rs 6,800 crore borrowing (59%). Cost figure is up Rs 500 crore.

ledger.promise: BTC to BTF (fluorination) or same-chemistry product volumes from Q1 FY27
ledger.quote: from Q1 FY27 onwards, we anticipate either BTC to BTF or other products which have the exact same chemistry.
ledger.actual: Q1 FY27 call: fluorination-based products will contribute next financial year (FY28), not FY27.

ledger.promise: Advanced Intermediates profitability: Q4 FY26 better than Q3, Q1 FY27 better still
ledger.quote: Q4 FY26 will be better, but Q1 FY27 will be better still.
ledger.actual: No segment data provided. The Q2 FY27 call refers to a sequential moderation in Advanced Intermediates profitability.

current_guidance.target: New record above the FY22 high of Rs 867 crore
current_guidance.quote: we'll be setting a new benchmark in annual performance for this segment by the end of the financial year.

current_guidance.target: Q3 between Q1 and Q2 levels, closer to Q1; Q4 better than Q3
current_guidance.quote: we expect Q3, in terms of EBIT percentage, somewhere between Q1 and Q2, I think closer to Q1 in terms of percentage.

current_guidance.quote: if I was to look at next year, it would be roughly in the range of about INR 400 crore, INR 420 crore. There is an upside available.

current_guidance.metric: Advanced Intermediates EBIT margin at steady state
current_guidance.quote: we should be targeting something along the lines of about 14% to 15% EBIT.

current_guidance.target: FY29, with phenol tied to the PDH feedstock plant (originally December 2027)
current_guidance.quote: So we continue to remain in line with our FY29 number.
So around INR 800 crore to INR 900 crore further in the second half.

current_guidance.target: Rs 2,200-2,400 crore FY28; Rs 2,500 crore FY29; Rs 2,500-3,000 crore FY30
current_guidance.quote: INR 2,200 crore-INR 2,400 crore next year, INR 2,500 crore in the second year, that is FY 2028- 2029, and balance in the third year, which will be in the range of INR 2,500 crore -INR 3,000 crore.
That is what we are looking at.

current_guidance.target: Present in Q3, full capacity soon
current_guidance.quote: It will certainly be seen and present in Q3, and we should be able to ramp up to full capacity very soon.

credibility.label: mixed
credibility.summary: Near-term profit guidance was met by wide margins: Q4 FY26 EBITDA of 376 beat Q3's 211, and Q1 FY27 EBITDA of 540 beat Q4's 376. Project promises have repeatedly slipped or been missed: MIBK/MIBC, alkylation, fluorination products and polycarbonate all moved later, the polycarbonate date moved three times, and nitric acid ran at 45% against a promised ~100%.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Q3 FY26 margin pressure was blamed on the nitric acid delay and buying nitric acid at spot rates, with the recovery tied to full in-house nitric acid use.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: The Q4 FY26 call put nitric acid at only 45% utilization, yet consolidated EBITDA margin rose to 17.7% in Q4 FY26 and 20.9% in Q1 FY27. The recovery came without the promised plant performance, and the materials do not show where it came from.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Q2 FY27: lower utilization at some plants, and Advanced Intermediates profitability moderated sequentially because of input prices, duties and freight.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Consolidated Q2 FY27 revenue rose 19% QoQ (2,578 to 3,076) and EBITDA rose from 540 to 627, while margin slipped only from 20.9% to 20.4%. The materials suggest the gain came from elsewhere (Phenolics record guidance), but no segment data confirms it.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Margins and gross numbers to improve through FY27.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: H1 FY27 EBITDA of 1,167 already exceeds full-year FY26 EBITDA of 987. TTM PAT is 1,062 vs 551 in FY26.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Peak debt of Rs 8,000-8,500 crore will be very comfortable, with debt-to-equity staying below 1.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Borrowings rose from 286 (FY24) to 1,762 (FY27) while operating cash flow fell from 874 to 539 (FY24-FY26) and the cash conversion cycle widened from 77 to 92 days. Peak debt would be about 4.5-4.8x current borrowings.

bull.point: Near-term earnings guidance has been met and beaten
bull.evidence: Q4 FY26 EBITDA 376 vs 211 in Q3 FY26. Q1 FY27 EBITDA 540 vs 376. Q2 FY27 PAT 398. TTM PAT 1,062 vs 551 in FY26.

bull.point: Specific earnings guidance on newly commissioned Advanced Intermediates assets
bull.evidence: About Rs 240 crore incremental EBIT in FY27 and Rs 400-420 crore in FY28, with a 14-15% EBIT margin target at steady state.

bull.point: Phenolics guided to a record year, and phase-1 projects appear to be getting capitalised
bull.evidence: FY27 Phenolics EBIT guided above the Rs 867 crore FY22 high. Capital WIP fell from 1,828 (FY26) to 1,299 (FY27) as MIBK/MIBC and acetophenone came onstream.

bear.evidence: MIBK/MIBC moved from Q4 FY26 to August 2026. Alkylation moved from June-July 2026 to commercial volumes in January 2027. Fluorination products moved to FY28. Polycarbonate moved from December 2027 to June 2028 to FY29.

bear.point: New plants are running below promised utilization
bear.evidence: Nitric acid was at about 45% against a promised 95-105%. MIBK/MIBC is at about 60%. Advanced Intermediates profitability moderated in Q2 FY27, and the Q3 margin is guided below Q1.

bear.point: Heavy capex and borrowing ahead while cash generation has weakened
bear.evidence: Planned capex of Rs 2,200-3,000 crore a year over FY28-FY30, with peak debt of Rs 8,000-8,500 crore vs borrowings of 1,762 now. Operating cash flow fell from 874 (FY24) to 539 (FY26), and the cash conversion cycle widened from 77 to 92 days.
